conservative.requirements: Requires S power. When you cast this spell, you how the moon (at least 1 moon must be in the sky). The difficulty is based on the number of targets; 1 is Easy (1d); 2-3 is Average (2d); 4-10 is Hard (3d), 11-50 is Daunting (4d), and 11-50 is Heroic (5d). Effect: While this spell is recharging, the targets find their ability to hunt greatly enhanced, their senses and instincts heightened to razor sharpness. Affected individuals add {Df}{Df} to checks described below.
conservative.name: Hunters Moon
